basis: Current exact goal descriptions/requires and complete effective witness chains were read for the role decision. Whole objects are frozen for replay; no new scientific-body or positive-profile approval is claimed.

decisions.scienceAndRoleRationale: The existing nucleic-acid classification goal requires the general qualitative functional-group competence, which explicitly requires carboxylic-acid recognition and acidic-character evidence. Retaining this authored foundational chain makes its mastery check available; this adds no carboxylic-acid task or assessment credit to the nucleic-acid endpoint and does not assert that carboxyl groups characterise nucleic acids.
decisions.whyNotTarget: The consumer assessment and its existing ordinary goals are already the intended scope. This entry is used only for global prerequisite mastery checks, with no added rendered target, progress denominator, assessment coverage, official source credit or automatic prerequisite mastery.

decisions.scienceAndRoleRationale: The existing qualitative/quantitative analgesic-analysis goal explicitly requires experimental/calculational mixture-content determination and method reliability. That quantitative foundation supports interpretation of the already covered medicine-analysis material; it is not an additional directly assessed goal or official NI learning target.
